# Password Generator 1.5.6

This patch release fixes the Android launcher icon packaging regression introduced with the previous artwork update.

## Fixed
- Restored the supplied Password Generator lock artwork as the canonical application icon.
- Rebuilt adaptive and legacy launcher resources from one canonical 512×512 source during every build.
- Fixed Android 8+ adaptive launchers, including Android 10 / VOS 3.0, showing the Android Studio placeholder icon.
- Synced the store icon asset with the application artwork.

Password generation, privacy behavior, settings and the About screen remain unchanged.
